notes.note: Reviewed the final scoped setup changes and unchanged authority contracts. Native-only shell now owns phone safe insets and the canonical device theme/shortcut controls via PageFrameActions; no operator or protected request is started by a theme toggle (mounted test). Help uses shared info, tooltip and popover primitives, hides the overlapping tooltip when open, and keeps required actions/errors/comparison visible. Installed iOS 26.5 simulator 46D7E454-B7FA-4846-80E7-C23E5295EF0E, io.kontourai.station.dev.instance, built at f5c6562112: inspected 402x874 dark/light screens and opened/dismissed help in both modes; title clears the status bar and help fits the viewport. Images /tmp/relay-final-help-dark.png and /tmp/relay-final-help-light.png. This is UI simulator evidence; physical Nightly, fresh public activation/member journey and provider qualification remain unverified.
